assertions.name: h4_refinement_alpha_close_to_one_and_m_p_close
assertions.source: Empirical α (= residual / h^4) ≈ 1 within 2%, and the refined λ = 1/(1-h_q·q^10) + h_q^4 gives m_p prediction within 1000 ppm of CODATA — a coherent +h^4 refinement candidate for the Bring color-tube form. Categorical origin of the +h^4 term (second-order Yekutieli per-cell vs Φ_q pentagon h^4 remainder vs modular dual) is the remaining R&D direction.

description: Refinement probe: Bring color-tube Φ_q pentagon `1/(1−h_q·q_0^10)` + α·h_q^4 correction, tested against the framework-correct λ target (m_p_CODATA back-solved through PR #942 flavor-split). Residual (m_avg target − Bring base) ≈ +1.011·h_q^4 — α ≈ 1 cleanly. Possible categorical origins: second-order Yekutieli per-cell (audit Step 4 R&D), Φ_q pentagon h^4 remainder, modular-dual instanton. Coefficient ≈ 1 (no internal q-deformation) most consistent with partition-algebra origin per audit hint.
